description: Pause a scheduled job's cron schedule. The job stops running on its schedule but is not deleted — it can be resumed with resume_job. Use when a job is failing repeatedly and you need time to diagnose, or to temporarily disable a job during maintenance. A paused job keeps its slot: a slot beyond the plan's stays billed (20 credits a month) until the job is deleted. Returns 404 if the project has no scheduled job.

job.description: The App's scheduled job, by its name (telbase jobs list).
